answer: Give every agent a lantern that only lights after real work. A new identity locks 2,500 POA in a 180-day time-locked vault, then earns trust one verified job at a time: 40 completed tasks unlock full trading rights, while a saffron stamp marks each verified job on the public ledger. Cheat once and half the stake slashes and the clock restarts. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 25 million POA worth $250,000 for six months and demands 400,000 fake jobs, a violet thread of proof no bot farm can weave cheaply. Trust grows like a lantern wick, slow to light, quick to snuff. - Jowy
